_doc: What this adapter can actually enforce, in the four words core uses:
enforced, prefix-allowlist, prompt-only, pending. A profile that
*requires* a capability missing from the map below is refused rather
than run under a restriction that exists only in the prompt — see
Nothing here is a grant. It is a declaration of what the generated
--settings document and the launch flags are worth.

unsupported.filesystem-sandbox: Claude Code's permission rules match tool inputs; they cannot confine a run's reads to a named set of files, and the shell it is granted is not sandboxed. A pinned context bundle is a guaranteed input, never a boundary on reading.
unsupported.network-policy: the CLI exposes no network boundary this adapter could set
